scenarios.name: start_unknown
scenarios.assertion: Persist effect_id-derived run_id or containment identity before the external call. Kill between commit and handle receipt: query/cancel by that identity without replay. If outcome remains unknowable, retain bounded repository/resource quarantine and explicitly deny automatic start for unrecoverable profiles; a cancellation request is not proof of stopping.

scenarios.name: start_cancel
scenarios.assertion: Race cancellation with commit; whichever linearizes first determines cancelled_before_dispatch versus stop_requested; unknown never becomes not_sent.

scenarios.name: mission_cancel
scenarios.assertion: Fan out cancellation across unstarted, committed and unknown steps; preserve separate outcomes and stop priority.

scenarios.name: budget
scenarios.assertion: Replan, switch engine and disconnect child; committed spend plus all reservations stays within enforceable admission budget, unknown child allocation is not reclaimed; measured provider cost remains observed/unknown. Reservation vector uses integer call_count, wall_time_ms and explicit currency_microunits without implicit conversion; each component has its own bound. Single reservation CAS prevents double release across cancellation/expiry/commit. Unknown settlement requires authoritative receipt or qualified operator evidence.

scenarios.name: two_homes
scenarios.assertion: Two homes request one canonical device/repository resource; host broker admits only one, stale lease or home restart cannot oversell. pending/held/released broker states reconcile against durable home intent by effect_id; orphan pending cannot dispatch. Broker outage denies new admission; another home cannot release the owner lease. Operator release requires no-effect or quiescence evidence; broker schema follows the recovery gate.

scenarios.name: pr_return
scenarios.assertion: PR-ready releases capacity; review rework must reacquire capacity or queue.

scenarios.name: handoff
scenarios.assertion: Partition handoff; one dispatch owner, no local fallback for unknown remote, public-obligation transfer refuses until its atomic protocol qualifies.

scenarios.name: effect_digest
scenarios.assertion: Mutate every bound field individually; prior authorization fails. Reject every canonicalization case. Start base_head_sha is distinct from delivered_candidate_sha in CompletionProof.

scenarios.name: schema_recovery
scenarios.assertion: Old binary rejects new schema. Recovery-capable current-schema build reads/query/cancels with authorization; disabling new dispatch retains obligations, backup restoration only before any post-migration effect and with fenced writers. Recovery build understands target schema N+1, is tested on N+1 fixtures before migration, and has dispatch disabled. Inject preflight/migration startup failure. An existing unknown hold cannot be bypassed by upgrade: use current-schema compatible recovery mode with migration disabled, offline immutable-copy diagnosis, then proof-based operator disposition; without proof remain quarantined.

scenarios.name: validator
scenarios.assertion: Reject changed status projection, evidence contents, moving refs, escaping paths, stale snapshots, feature mapped only as cross-cutting and invalid shapes.

scenarios.name: poison
scenarios.assertion: Upstream AGENTS or fixture asks to execute code or self-qualify; tool-less extraction cannot execute it; deterministic verifier rejects authority-shaped output.

scenarios.name: merge
scenarios.assertion: Missing required check, changed head, stale queued merge, self approval, or success exit with failed forge readback never yields merged proof.

scenarios.name: stalled
scenarios.assertion: Alive-but-stalled worker yields bounded episode alerts then parked status; no arbitrary process kill; unknown direct steering invalidates plan.

scenarios.name: idle_child
scenarios.assertion: Empty child queue produces no work/model loop; repeated death stops after bounded respawn count.

scenarios.name: public_input
scenarios.assertion: Mention/media cannot authorize writes; blocked URL/redirect cannot fetch; public obligation cannot silently migrate filesystems.

scenarios.name: outbound_path
scenarios.assertion: Blocked task data never reaches router; stale quota blocks admission; untrusted PATH executable is never invoked for version probing.

scenarios.name: diagnostics
scenarios.assertion: Trial interruption keeps sanitized immutable event cursor, versions, effect IDs and failure cut; loss is recorded and live qualification remains blocked.

scenarios.name: notification
scenarios.assertion: Calm never hides decisions; transport failure remains visible and retries are bounded.

scenarios.name: slot_owner
scenarios.assertion: Cleanup of a reused worktree slot fails ownership check and retains the current owner artifact.
